title: Moving of Ashoka Pillar at Topra
subject: History
caption: Illustration of the 1356 CE relocation of the Ashoka Pillar from Topra to Delhi.
altText: A photorealistic textbook-style drawing on a white background showing the Ashoka Pillar being moved in 1356 CE. The marble pillar, inscribed with ancient Brahmi script, rests on wooden rollers. Oxen pull the rollers while a group of laborers operate simple pulleys. Sultan Firuz Shah Tughlaq stands nearby, directing the effort. Each component—pillar, oxen, rollers, pulleys, and laborers—is clearly labelled with concise text. In the corner, a small map marks Topra and Delhi, linked by a dotted arrow indicating the direction of transport. The illustration is high resolution, historically accurate, and includes realistic lighting and textures.
